name: Korean K9 Rescue (KK9R)
neighborhoods: Queens/LIC-based; adopts within ~150 miles of NYC (some case-by-case exceptions)
notes: 501(c)(3) No-Kill based in Queens/LIC and Bundang, South Korea. Transports dogs rescued in South Korea plus local at-risk NYC dogs as an ACC New Hope partner. Foster-based in NYC (dogs live in foster homes until adopted). Thorough screening: requires proper supplies and adopter enrolls in training.
